management_remarks: During Q3 FY25, TCS achieved record TCV bookings of USD 10.2 billion in a seasonally soft quarter, with zero mega-deal dependency and strong broad-based deal velocity. Operating margin expanded 40 basis points sequentially to 24.5% driven by pyramid optimization, sub-contractor rationalization, and AI-assisted delivery productivity. Over 270 GenAI engagements moved into live production across BFSI, retail, and life sciences clients, validating enterprise adoption.
analyst_qa: On the gap between strong TCV bookings and reported revenue growth, leaky bucket scope reductions on older contracts and cautious client ramp-ups create near-term headwinds. Healthcare and telecom verticals remain volatile and challenging as enterprise CIOs stay calibrated on quarterly budget releases. Short-term furloughs and uncertain US interest rate trajectories keep near-term conversion timing moderating.
